title: The local module proxy writes the wrong go.mod and no time

evidence.verified: TestLocalModuleProxyServesTheRevisionNotTheTree passes. With go.mod edited in the working tree, the proxy serves the revision's own go.mod, and its `.info` carries the commit's time. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 3b3e213, once the nested sandbox smoke job was run again: its microVM had stopped answering.

resolution: The local module proxy takes go.mod from the revision it zips rather than from the working tree. Its `.info` carries the commit's time as well as the version.
details: `localModuleProxy` zips a revision but copies go.mod from the working tree, so a checkout with an edited go.mod serves a manifest that does not match its zip. Go records the manifest's hash in go.sum, so the line it writes is wrong. Its `.info` carries only `Version`, with no `Time`, which Go reads to order versions.
